title: 第21章 苏家之争第22章 事不过三张宿拔剑
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
“管伯，这三房和长房究竟怎么回事？”
“还有，大哥在苏家这一年，处境究竟如何？”
张宿一连问了两个问题。
管伯看了张宿一眼，随后长叹了一声，详细解释道：“其实，大少爷在长房的处境还是很不错的。大少爷与少夫人很恩爱，长房老爷最近几年身体不好，基本上已经将长房的生意都交给了少夫人。”
“明面上是少夫人做主，可实际上，少夫人对大少爷几乎是言听计从，苏家长房的生意，基本上也都是大少爷在打理。而且这一年时间，大少爷也将生意打理得井井有条。”
“不过，大少爷越是出色，苏家其他两房就越是不满。苏家一共有三房，其中长房这一支掌握着苏家主导权。二房人丁稀薄，也没什么出彩的人物，在苏家早就被边缘化了。”
“问题就出在三房。长房只有少夫人这么一个独女，本来等长房老爷过世，苏家的生意就会交给三房，可大少爷却入赘了苏家，关键大少爷还做的不错，这相当于抢了三房入主苏家的机会，所以三房就处处针对大少爷。”
管伯解释得很清楚。
张宿也立刻就明白了。
现在的苏家，就是三房与长房的矛盾。
三房想要主导苏家生意，本来长房人丁稀薄，只有一个独女，三房是有机会的。
结果大哥入赘苏家长房，让三房希望落空。
那三房的人不得恨死大哥了？
难怪此前在大门外，三房二小姐看到张宿，居然有那么强烈的敌意。
现在张宿一切都明白了。
这倒是与张宿想的不太一样。
张宿还以为大哥在苏家忍辱负重，郁郁不得志。
没想到，压根就没有这回事。
嫂子“宠夫心切”，主动把长房的权利让渡给大哥。
大哥也挺有能力。

现在几乎主导了长房的生意，是长房的实际掌控人。
在长房说话也是一言九鼎。
这处境，相当好了。
唯一的麻烦，或许就是三房对大哥的针锋相对了。
“管伯，我能去看看吗？”
张宿问道。
虽然是在苏家，就算大哥和三房的人打起来了，应该也不会有太大的事。
但张宿还是想去看看。
毕竟，耳听为虚眼见为实。
大哥在苏家处境究竟如何，这个时候去看一眼便知道了。
“这……”
管伯想了想，最后还是点了点头道：“二少爷是归元派外门弟子，这个身份也是有分量的，说不定还能帮到大少爷。二少爷请随我来吧……”
张宿点了点头。
于是，小妹张令仪留在了院子里。
张宿便和管伯一起，前往苏家议事大厅。
……
苏家议事厅。
苏家三房的下人，与长房的下人正在紧张地对峙。
苏千鹤满脸阴沉。
张辰虽然衣服有些凌乱，但整体倒是没什么大事，甚至依旧一副风度翩翩的模样。
content_en:
"Uncle Guan, what's going on with the third bedroom and the eldest bedroom?"
"Also, how has the eldest brother been in the Su family this year?"
Zhang Su asked two questions in a row.
Uncle Guan glanced at Zhang Su, then sighed and explained in detail: "Actually, the eldest young master's situation in the eldest house is quite good. The eldest young master and the young madam are very affectionate. The eldest young master has been in poor health in recent years, and has basically handed over all the eldest house's business to the young madam."
"Obviously, the young madam is the one who makes the decision, but in fact, the young madam almost obeys the eldest young master. The business of Su's family house is basically taken care of by the eldest young master. And during this year, the eldest young master has also managed the business in an orderly manner."
"However, the more outstanding the eldest young master is, the more dissatisfied the other two families of the Su family are. There are three families in the Su family, and the eldest family has the leadership of the Su family. The second family has only a few people, and there are no outstanding figures. They have long been marginalized in the Su family."
"The problem lies in the third room. The eldest brother only has an only daughter, the young lady. Originally, when the eldest father passed away, the Su family's business would be handed over to the third room, but the eldest young master married into the Su family. The key point is that the eldest young master did well. This is equivalent to robbing the third room of the opportunity to take over the Su family, so the third room targeted the eldest young master in every possible way."
Guan Bo explained it very clearly.
Zhang Su also understood immediately.
The Su family now has a conflict between the third room and the eldest room.
The third family wanted to dominate the Su family's business. Originally, the eldest family member had only one daughter, so the third family had a chance.
As a result, the eldest brother moved into the family room of Su's family, which frustrated the third family's hopes.
Then the people in the third room must hate their eldest brother to death?
No wonder the second lady of the third room was so hostile when she saw Zhang Su outside the gate.
Now Zhang Su understands everything.
This is not what Zhang Su thought.
Zhang Su thought that his eldest brother was suffering from humiliation in the Su family and was depressed.
Unexpectedly, there was no such thing.
The sister-in-law was "eager to pamper her husband" and took the initiative to transfer the rights of the eldest son to her eldest brother.
The eldest brother is also quite capable.
Now he almost dominates the business of Changfang and is the actual controller of Changfang.
Even when talking in the long room, he always sticks to his words.
This situation is quite good.
The only trouble may be the tit-for-tat confrontation between the third house and the eldest brother.
"Uncle Guan, can I go and have a look?"
Zhang Su asked.
Even though we were in the Su family, even if the eldest brother got into a fight with someone from the third room, it wouldn't be a big deal.
But Zhang Su still wanted to take a look.
After all, seeing is believing.
What is the situation of the eldest brother in the Su family? You will know if you take a look at it at this time.
"This..."
Guan Bo thought for a while, and finally nodded and said: "The second young master is an outer disciple of the Guiyuan sect. This status is also important. Maybe he can help the eldest young master. Second young master, please come with me..."
Zhang Su nodded.
So, the younger sister Zhang Lingyi stayed in the yard.
Zhang Su then went to the Su family meeting hall with Guan Bo.
…
Su family meeting hall.
The servants from the third room of the Su family were having a tense confrontation with the servants from the eldest room.
Su Qianhe's face was gloomy.
Although Zhang Chen's clothes were a little messy, there was nothing serious about him overall, and he even still looked elegant.
